create.name: Kevin James Carroll
create.bio:
Kevin James Carroll is an Australian singer, chant leader and shakuhachi player who grew up in Lorne on the Victorian coast. Travels through Asia, and a first trip to India in 1990, brought him into contact with Tibetan Buddhism, Dzogchen, yoga and devotional chanting, and he then spent around ten years living simply in far north Queensland to deepen that practice. After a short spell fronting a festival band in Byron Bay he turned instead to small community chanting gatherings, which over seven years of weekly meetings led to his first album, ONE, in 2010. Since then he has lived mostly on the road.

His Heartsong chanting circles mix Sanskrit and other sacred mantras, call-and-response kirtan and English songs that carry ideas from Eastern philosophy, often closing with the shakuhachi. He presents this as bhakti yoga open to people of any faith or none. With his wife Susana Rodríguez on harmonium he leads circles, sound journeys and festival workshops across Europe and Australia, retreats in places such as Bali and Corfu, and a week-long course for people who want to lead chanting themselves. He also teaches a morning practice of toning through the chakras that he calls Active Aum Meditation. His Insight Timer library holds flute meditations and mantra recordings.

courses.title: Heartsong Chanting Circles
courses.description: Evening gatherings where Kevin and Susana lead mantras, kirtan and English Heartsongs for everyone in the room to sing. Circles, sound journeys and festival appearances are listed by city on his events calendar, mostly in Spain, the rest of Europe and Australia.

courses.title: The Way to the Heart: Yoga and Mantra Journey to Bali
courses.description: A twelve-day trip through Bali run by Shama Retreats, with daily yoga from organiser Paloma Dorado and chanting with Kevin and Susana. It includes the island's day of silence, Nyepi, and finishes in Ubud.
courses.price: From 1.780€ (EUR) for the 5-11 March retreat only; full journey from 2.650€ (EUR)

courses.title: Opening the Heart: Yoga and Mantra Retreat in Corfu
courses.description: A week at the ineayoga centre in the south of Corfu, pairing gentle yoga classes with daily mantra circles led by Kevin and Susana. Afternoons are left free for rest and the sea; no previous experience is needed.

courses.title: Chanting Circle Facilitator Course
courses.description: A residential week near Munich for yoga teachers and musicians who want to lead kirtan and mantra circles. It covers holding the room, sound set-up, songwriting, recording, voice care and the business side, with a public circle on the last night.

free_resources.title: Kevin James Carroll on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Shakuhachi flute meditations, devotional chants such as the Gayatri and longer meditation music sets. The single tracks are free to hear.

flags: He is first a devotional musician; he passes as a teacher because he leads chanting circles, retreats, voice workshops and a facilitator course, but a human may want to confirm he fits.

Most of his YouTube channel is music; I kept the explainer, the flute story, sound journeys and the full live Helsinki chanting circle (participatory kirtan), and left out lyric videos and songs. A human may still judge the chanting circle recordings as music-only.
Insight Timer gives Byron Bay as his base, but his own site says he and Susana live nomadically and most events are in Spain, Europe and Australia, so availability is set to worldwide with no city.
Instagram, Facebook and YouTube accounts are branded Kevin James Music and feature Susana too; I counted them as his own as they carry his name. Total ~70k stays under 100k either way.
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch (first sentence plus a paraphrase); the bio check relied mainly on his own site pages.
Possible related listing: Susana Rodríguez co-leads everything; she is not listed separately.
left_out: Retreat in Arillas, Corfu (1-6 Aug 2027, Corfu Buddha Hall): fully booked with a waiting list only.
Single-date events (Valencia chanting circle 6 Nov, sound journey 8 Nov, Madrid Symphonic Kirtan 19 Dec, festivals): covered by the Heartsong Chanting Circles item pointing at the events calendar.
YouTube lyric and song videos (Essence of All, Maa, Asatoma acoustic, Ong Namo, Shri Ram), meditation music tracks, and clips under 2 minutes; the Helsinki track titled 'Healing' left out to be safe.
Albums, songbooks and downloads in his online shop: music, not books; no authored books found.
No Insight Timer courses on his profile.
